# IntelliPlan

> IntelliPlan is a student planner for scheduling coursework around classes, calendar commitments, and available study time. It also offers tutoring, grade modeling, and study practice.

## Product and policy

- [Study planner and worked example](https://intelliplan.tech/study-planner): How the planner fits homework around available hours and flags work that still needs time.
- [Interactive sample week](https://intelliplan.tech/demo/planner): Fictional coursework you can plan and adjust without an account.
- [FAQ](https://intelliplan.tech/faq): Supported connections, scheduling behavior, and getting started.
- [Pricing](https://intelliplan.tech/pricing): Current free features, AI usage limits, and paid options where available.
- [Privacy and terms](https://intelliplan.tech/legal): Student data practices, account eligibility, and deletion. New independent accounts for children under 13 are unavailable while a reviewed authorization process is pending.
- [For schools](https://intelliplan.tech/schools): Information for schools and districts.
